publishedfiledetails.title: [Replaceable with Any Character] Chaos Dream — Rosewitha Skin
publishedfiledetails.description:
Roswitha  is from Chaos Zero Nightmare. The character to be replaced can be freely selected. This is a purely cosmetic mod.
When loading this mod and entering the game, it may take some time to preload effects so that the in-game effects run smoothly. Thank you for your understanding.
It includes visual effects and audio (which can be optionally disabled).
This mod is an unofficial, non-commercial fan-made work. If there is any infringement, please let me know, and I will promptly modify or delete the relevant content.
